summary: Boston Beer Co Inc filed an 8-K Item 8.01 to report the entry of an amended final judgment in a supplier dispute with Ardagh Metal Packaging USA Corp. On May 26, 2026, the court entered a $175.5 million damages award with $15.5 million pre-judgment interest, totaling $191 million. The company had previously recorded a $212 million pre-tax expense in Q1 2026; the lower interest decreases expense by $21 million, boosting GAAP EPS by $1.52 per diluted share. Boston Beer denies breaching the contract and plans to pursue posttrial motions and appeals. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is a routine legal update.
